blocks.text: Imagine you're writing a story, but some sentences feel incomplete. How can you make them whole?

blocks.markdown: Sentence completion is a crucial skill in English, especially in exams like WAEC, NECO, and JAMB. This involves filling in gaps in sentences with the correct words or phrases to ensure grammatical accuracy and idiomatic expression.

blocks.title: What is Sentence Completion?
blocks.text: Sentence completion requires selecting the appropriate word or phrase to fill in the blanks, ensuring the sentence is both grammatically correct and idiomatic.

blocks.markdown: To effectively complete sentences, one must understand the context and the grammatical structure required. This includes knowing the correct tense, preposition, or conjunction to use, as well as choosing idiomatic expressions.

blocks.title: Example of Sentence Completion
blocks.prompt: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence: 'She is interested ___ learning new languages.'

steps.text: Identify the context of the sentence.
The correct preposition to use with 'interested' is 'in'.

blocks.markdown: When completing sentences, remember to reject options that, while grammatically correct, do not sound natural in context. This skill is essential for achieving high marks in your exams.

blocks.title: Tip for Sentence Completion
blocks.text: Always read the entire sentence before choosing an option. This helps you understand the context and select the most appropriate word or phrase.

points: Sentence completion tests your understanding of grammar and idiomatic expressions.
Practice regularly to improve your ability to fill in gaps accurately.
